snippet.title: Adorable Adventures Gameplay Trailer - Future Games Show Spring Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
An adventure game about a baby boar with a remarkable sense of smell, Adorable Adventures sniffled its way into our hearts thanks to a brand new gameplay trailer that debuted during the Spring Showcase. Reunite Boris's family when the game launches on PC, PlayStation and Xbox on April 30th, 2026.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3840230/Adorable_Adventures/

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
